baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ joined to رِحْلَةَ and the paired seasonal genitives
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated departure across the two seasonal poles becomes familiar attachment: movement is not a one-off trip but a practiced mode of continuity.

activation_trace.role: Familiar attachment and habituated staying make recurrent movement a settled collective habit.
Going forth toward a destination supplies the concrete repeated motion carried by that habit.
Winter supplies one recurring temporal pole of the practiced movement.
Summer supplies the opposed recurring pole that closes the annual rhythm.

changed_reading.before: A journey associated with winter and summer.
changed_reading.after: A winter-summer movement repeated until mobility itself becomes their familiar mode of attachment and continuity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compositional potential of إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ across رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Distinct stages, quarters, and season-bound actions are joined into one circuit; coherence is an achieved arrangement of heterogeneous parts.

activation_trace.role: Joining separated parts into a composition turns the two seasons and journey stages into one organized system.
A stopping stage between departures supplies the modular units from which the circuit is assembled.
Wintering and winter quarters make the cold season a situated phase rather than a bare date.
Summer residence and season-bound action provide the complementary operational phase.

changed_reading.before: Two seasonal journeys placed side by side.
changed_reading.after: A composed circuit whose winter quarters, summer operations, and intermediate stages function as interlocking parts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رِحْلَةَ as both travel and the material-spatial complex carried through the seasons
baseline_models.mechanism: The journey transports its own apparatus and provisional dwelling; seasonal continuity depends on mounts, gear, lodging, and readiness moving together.

activation_trace.role: Saddle gear makes the journey materially equipped rather than abstract motion.
Dwelling space and travelling belongings make mobility capable of carrying a provisional home.
A mount made fit after weakness supplies the readiness condition for sustaining the mobile system.
Winter quarters provide one temporary emplacement for the travelling household.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Seasonal journey as a joined circuit.** Lexical evidence: ء ل ف B002/B005 (joining parts; familiar attachment), ر ح ل B001/B006 (journeying; stages), ش ت و B001 and ص ي ف B001 (winter and summer seasons). Structural cue: 106:2 repeats "إِيلَاف" from 106:1 and apposes it to the singular "رِحْلَةَ" spanning two seasons. Assigned role: ء ل ف binds the two opposite seasons and the route stages into a coherent annual circuit. Abductive move: I infer that the singular journey is conceptual, a patterned system made from repeated seasonal departures. Reading change: the fixed ayah reads as an ordered calendar of movement, not just two separate trips.

2. **Journey equipment and bodily readiness.** Lexical evidence: ر ح ل B002/B003/B005 (camel saddle gear; placing the saddle; fit riding mount), ع ب د B005/B011 in 106:3 (made passable/subdued; stranded by failed mount), and ط ع م B007/B009 in 106:4 (animal fatness; eliciting a horse's run). Structural cue: the travel noun sits between habituation and divine feeding/security; the packet's branch inventory makes travel materially dependent on animals, gear, and physical condition. Assigned role: ر ح ل supplies the apparatus; ع ب د and ط ع م supply passability, animal strength, and motion. Abductive move: I infer that the ayah's "journey" includes the maintenance of travel capacity, not only the act of going. Reading change: the fixed ayah becomes logistical: saddles, mounts, strength, and reliable roads are latent in "رِحْلَةَ".

3. **Winter and summer as risk ecology.** Lexical evidence: ش ت و B004 (winter as famine/privation), ج و ع B002 in 106:4 (famine-time), ص ي ف B002/B003 (summer rain; summer-season provisions or transactions), and ط ع م B004/B005 (livelihood; ripening produce). Structural cue: the two seasons in 106:2 are answered by "from hunger" in 106:4. Assigned role: winter activates scarcity; summer activates rain, produce, and seasonal provision. Abductive move: I infer that seasonal travel is a strategy for passing through alternating ecological threats and opportunities. Reading change: "الشتاء والصيف" no longer functions as a simple time label; it becomes a map of famine, rain, ripening, and livelihood.

4. **Journey as displacement held short of expulsion.** Lexical evidence: ر ح ل B001 (going forth), B007 (driving away/dislodging), B009 (burdening with harm), خ و ف B001/B002 in 106:4 (fear; making afraid), and ء م ن B001 (safe-conduct). Structural cue: the same movement root can describe chosen travel or being forced away; the final ayah says they are secured from fear. Assigned role: the darker ر ح ل branches provide the threatened underside of mobility. Abductive move: I infer that safe seasonal circulation is distinguished from traumatic removal by the gift of security. Reading change: the fixed ayah reads as protected mobility: travel remains journey rather than exile, harassment, or harmful burdening.

5. **Journey as temporary dwelling.** Lexical evidence: ر ح ل B004/B006 (one's dwelling and travelling belongings; stage between stops), ب ي ت B001/B005/B006 in 106:3 (shelter; one night's provision; things kept overnight), and ر ب ب B007 (staying/clinging/lasting). Structural cue: "رِحْلَةَ" is followed by "البيت"; the journey inventory itself includes dwellings and stages. Assigned role: ر ح ل makes each stop a portable house, while ب ي ت gives the fixed house that organizes the whole circuit. Abductive move: I infer that the travel system alternates between temporary shelters and a central sanctuary-house. Reading change: 106:2 becomes about inhabited movement, not empty transit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later ayat changed "رِحْلَةَ" from an itinerary into a maintained capacity. 106:3's "فَلْيَعْبُدُوا" activated ع ب د B005, so the journey can be imagined as a road made passable and socially subdued; 106:4 activated the bodily and economic conditions of travel through feeding and security. The sharper surprise came from the darker branches: ر ح ل B007/B009 made the same motion vulnerable to expulsion and harmful burdening, while ء م ن B001 in 106:4 prevents that reading from taking over by converting movement into safe-conduct. The seasonal nouns also became less neutral after 106:4: ش ت و B004 and ج و ع B002 turn winter into possible famine-time, while ص ي ف B002/B003 and ط ع م B005 turn summer into rain, ripening, and provision.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A composed seasonal circuit.** Fixed `إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ` activates `ء ل ف B002` (joining separate things into a composition), while fixed `رِحْلَةَ` activates both `ر ح ل B001` (going forth) and `ر ح ل B006` (a stage between departures). The coordinated fixed terms `ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ` (`ش ت و B001`; `ص ي ف B001`) divide time into contrasting components, and the next ayah's `هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ` supplies a stable spatial point. `إِۦلَٰف` joins the components; `رِحْلَة` turns them into linked stages. I infer a circuit and return relation from recurring seasons plus the fixed house, since neither destination nor return is stated. The ayah thus reads as an organized time-space system rather than a generic trip in two seasons.

2. **Journey includes portable dwelling and logistical readiness.** The fixed `رِحْلَةَ` activates dormant material branches: `ر ح ل B002` (camel saddle gear), `ر ح ل B004` (dwelling and travelling belongings), `ر ح ل B005` (a fit mount), and `ر ح ل B008` (journey aid). Their proximity to the later sheltering `بَيْت` (`ب ي ت B001`) and security (`ء م ن B001`) makes equipment, carried household, readiness, and aid a coherent support layer. These branches assign the journey a material body that mediates between the stationary house and exposed movement. The packet supplies gear/readiness branches, house, and security; I infer that this support layer enables the seasonal journey. `رِحْلَة` consequently reads as an equipped mobile dwelling-practice, not motion stripped of infrastructure.

3. **Winter activates a scarcity-management reading.** Fixed `ٱلشِّتَآءِ` ordinarily activates `ش ت و B001`, but final `جُوع` opens its dormant `ش ت و B004` variant image, winter as famine or privation; `ج و ع B002` likewise names a famine-time. The winter/summer coordination and the later causative feeding (`ط ع م B002`) place the journey between a periodic threat and its remedy. Winter scarcity supplies the pressure, the journey supplies the adaptive operation, and feeding supplies the successful outcome. The packet does not say that travel causes the food supply, so journey -> mitigation is the abductive arrow. The seasonal journey now reads as resilience against recurrent deprivation, not merely travel dated by a calendar.

4. **The season pair also carries an ecological production cycle.** Fixed winter activates `ش ت و B003` (winter rain), and fixed summer activates `ص ي ف B002` (summer rain together with vegetation and pasture); later feeding activates `ط ع م B005` (fruit ripening and taking flavor), while `ر ب ب B002` supplies stage-by-stage nurture. The balanced winter/summer nouns are the structural cue for two differentiated resource regimes. Their assigned role is ecological input, with maturation and feeding as downstream output. I infer rain/seasonal conditions -> ripening provision; only the summer branch explicitly includes the vegetation link. This coexists with the privation reading: the ayah can present the journey as moving through productive ecologies as well as managing their failures.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `106:3` retrospectively activated the dwelling/belongings scope of fixed `رِحْلَة` (`ر ح ل B004`): journey now mediates between portable lodging and `هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ`, and the house turns stages into an inferred circuit. `106:4` produced two less obvious revisions. Its `جُوع` opened winter's privation branch (`ش ت و B004`), while `أَطْعَمَهُم` opened the rain-to-ripening ecology (`ش ت و B003`; `ص ي ف B002`; `ط ع م B005`); its security clause also made the gear, fit-mount, and journey-aid branches function as protected logistics rather than lexical curiosities.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Accustomed Seasonal Itinerary
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A recurring winter-and-summer route becomes familiar to its travelers and part of an established communal rhythm.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: familiar attachment `ء ل ف:B005/m01`; domesticated familiarity `ء ل ف:B005/m02`; departure and travel `ر ح ل:B001/m01`; winter season `ش ت و:B001/m01`; summer season `ص ي ف:B001/m01`; summer as a deadline of neglect or fulfilled need `ص ي ف:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Repetition turns departure into an accustomed itinerary: people, places, and even domestic creatures can become familiar through continued association. Winter and summer mark the route's alternating phases, while the summer proverb recasts the season as the point when preparation either bears fruit or proves neglected.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir şeyden yön değiştirip uzaklaşmayı ve bir şeyi başka yöne çevirmeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Okun hedeften sapması, su yatağının eğriliği ve zararın birinden uzaklaştırılması bu çekirdeğin farklı katılımcı ve sonuç düzenleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yazla ilgili anlamlardan ayrıdır; yönelinen çizgiden veya nesneden sapmayı, eğrilmiş yolu ve bir şeyin başka yöne çevrilmesini kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın sapma çekirdeğini korur; ok, su yatağı ve zararı uzaklaştırma kullanımlarını ayrı yapıya bağlı özel gerçekleşmeler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyden yön değiştirerek sapmak veya bir şeyi başka yöne çevirip ondan uzaklaştırmaktır. Okun hedefinden sapması, su yatağının eğri olması ve bir zararın kişiden uzaklaştırılması bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Bir hareketli şey yöneldiği nesneden sapar veya bir etken başka bir şeyi o nesneden uzaklaştırır.
Bir ok hedefe giden çizgisinden ayrılarak hedefinden sapabilir.
Bir su yatağının düz doğrultudan ayrılmış eğri bölümü aynı yön sapmasıyla tanımlanır.
Bir kişinin karşılaşacağı zarar başka yöne çevrilerek o kişiden uzaklaştırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyden sapma ve onu başka yöne çevirme çekirdeğini ortaklaştırır; okun hedeften ayrılması, eğri su yatağı ve zararın uzaklaştırılması bu yön değişiminin farklı uygulamalarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü yaz sözcüğünü içeren iki kalıplaşmış anlatımı birlikte verir, ancak bunlar tek bir ortak yargı taşımaz: biri zamanında değerlendirilmeyen fırsatı, diğeri bir işin tamamlanmasını anlatır. Dal yalnız bu iki yapıya bağlı bir kullanım kümesi olarak korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalın yaz anlamı değildir ve iki sözü tek bir anlamda birleştirmez; her sözün kendi iletisi, yalnız o kalıplaşmış yapı içinde korunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kaynakta verilen iki kalıplaşmış söze bağlıdır; bunların fırsatı kaçırma ve tamamlanma iletileri yalın kök anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaz sözcüğünü içeren iki ayrı kalıplaşmış sözden oluşan, tek bir ortak yargıya indirgenemeyen bir kullanım kümesidir. Bir söz zamanında değerlendirilmeyen fırsatı kınar, öteki baharla yaz arasındaki ilişki üzerinden tamamlanmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: İki kullanım da yaz sözcüğünü sabit bir sözün parçası yapar, fakat iletileri birbirinden ayrıdır.
İlk söz, yapılması gerekeni zamanında yapmayıp fırsatı kaçıran kişiye yöneltilir.
İkinci söz, baharın yazla tamamlanması üzerinden bir ihtiyacın veya işin eksiksiz bitmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Dalın ortak noktası, iki kullanımın da yaz sözünü kalıplaşmış bir anlatımın parçası yapmasıdır; fırsatı kaçırma ile tamamlanma iletileri birbirinden ayrıdır.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynak, zamanında fırsatı kaçırmayı kınayan sözü ve baharın yazla tamamlandığını bildiren sözü birlikte aktarır.
